Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 9
Federal
Nepal
Parliament,
Daily Agenda
2083 Jestha 7, Thursday
11:00 AM
Management Work
Honorable Prime Minister and Home Minister, Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation
1. On behalf of Balendra Shah, Honorable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam:
(a) "Consider the Representative Council Member Election (First Amendment) Bill, 2083"
(b) "Consider the Voter Roll (First Amendment) Bill, 2083"
(c) "Consider the National Forensic Science Laboratory (Establishment and Operation) Bill, 2081"
2. Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present a proposal to "Discuss the Alternative Development Finance Mobilization Bill, 2082 clause by clause in the House."
3. The proposed amendments to the said bill will be presented for decision.
4. Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present a proposal to "Pass the Alternative Development Finance Mobilization Bill, 2082."
Panchan Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
